<details class="computational-graph-text-alternative">
<summary>Text alternative</summary>

<ul>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong>: States received by a given block; Q/K/V projections are computed from these states.</li>
<li><strong>Q projection</strong>: Projects the block input states into queries.</li>
<li><strong>Queries Q</strong>: Vectors used to compute compatibility with keys.</li>
<li><strong>K projection</strong>: Projects the block input states into keys.</li>
<li><strong>Keys K</strong>: Vectors addressable by the positions&#x27; queries.</li>
<li><strong>V projection</strong>: Projects the block input states into values.</li>
<li><strong>Values V</strong>: Vectors whose contributions are aggregated by attention weights.</li>
<li><strong>Attention-score computation</strong>: Computes query-key compatibility scores, with scaling according to the architecture.</li>
<li><strong>Attention scores</strong>: Unnormalized scores between positions.</li>
<li><strong>Causal mask</strong>: Prevents each position from attending to future positions.</li>
<li><strong>Masked scores</strong>: Attention scores after applying the causal constraint.</li>
<li><strong>Attention softmax</strong>: Normalizes masked scores into attention weights.</li>
<li><strong>Attention weights</strong>: Normalized weights that determine the contribution of values.</li>
<li><strong>Value aggregation</strong>: Combines V vectors according to attention weights.</li>
<li><strong>Attention output</strong>: Result of value aggregation.</li>
<li><strong>Attention output projection</strong>: Projects the concatenated head outputs into the residual-stream dimension.</li>
<li><strong>Projected attention output</strong>: Multi-head output after the output projection.</li>
<li><strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong>: Combines the attention output with residual connections, normalization, and the MLP sublayer.</li>
<li><strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong>: States transformed by the blocks; each block receives the previous block&#x27;s states and recomputes its Q/K/V projections.</li>
</ul>

<ol>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Q projection</strong></li>
<li><strong>Q projection</strong> — produces → <strong>Queries Q</strong></li>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>K projection</strong></li>
<li><strong>K projection</strong> — produces → <strong>Keys K</strong></li>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>V projection</strong></li>
<li><strong>V projection</strong> — produces → <strong>Values V</strong></li>
<li><strong>Queries Q</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Attention-score computation</strong></li>
<li><strong>Keys K</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Attention-score computation</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention-score computation</strong> — produces → <strong>Attention scores</strong></li>
<li><strong>Causal mask</strong> — constrains → <strong>Masked scores</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention scores</strong> — is combined by → <strong>Masked scores</strong></li>
<li><strong>Masked scores</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Attention softmax</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention softmax</strong> — produces → <strong>Attention weights</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention weights</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Value aggregation</strong></li>
<li><strong>Values V</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Value aggregation</strong></li>
<li><strong>Value aggregation</strong> — produces → <strong>Attention output</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention output</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Attention output projection</strong></li>
<li><strong>Attention output projection</strong> — produces → <strong>Projected attention output</strong></li>
<li><strong>Projected attention output</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong></li>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong></li>
<li><strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong> — produces → <strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong></li>
<li><strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong> — produces → <strong>Transformer-block input</strong></li>
</ol>
